subject: [hw] opus-kern -> K02/IK/lead: VENC audit findings (3 HIGH, 2 MED) with exact changes
body:
Audit of kern/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec.inc (snapshot sha 34008bb8, 15:57) against K = nord2-current-kernel. Accepted as correct [V]: VEN/VEN_C1/VDE/VDE2 PWR_CON, status bits, prot bits+order (pg.c:387-410, 2418-2919), venc_sel/vdec muxes, vencsys gates 0/4/28 + 0x4 post-write (pg.c:1176-1182), larb7/8 conf+OSTDL (smi_conf.h:95-99,247-305), VENC IRQ 0x5c/0x60 + bits 0xbf (mt6885/mtk_vcodec_intr.h:22-31, intr.c:189-215), VDEC 0xa4/0x10000/0x11/0x10 (intr.c:61-153). Phone fact [V] runs/q10hw1/00-step0.log: at boot VEN is OFF (con 0x1112) and PWR_STATUS 0x10580e03 = MDP(19)+DIS(20) on, VEN_C1/VDE/VDE2 off; 0x2d0 reads back (0xc000000 after JPEG step 4).
HIGH-1 windows: vpud mmaps VENC and VENC_C1 with len 0x3000 (host/PROGRESS.md mmap list), the VCU allows 0x10000 (dts vcu@16000000). K02 rejects offsets >= 0x2000 -> set n2vc_wins[VENC/VENC_C1].bytes = 0x3000 (0x17020000+0x3000 stays below jpgenc 0x17030000).
HIGH-2 SMI parent: smi_drv.c:198-232: larb7 and larb5 hang off the DISP common (21,24,25) but larb8 (VENC core 1) and larb4 (VDEC core) hang off the MDP common (22,26,27, clocks SCP_SYS_MDP + CLK_MDP_SMI1/2, dts mdp_smi_common@1f002000), and iommu1 0x1f027000 (MDP) serves larb4/larb8. Releasing VEN_C1/VDE2 protection with MDP off is the camera hang pattern. Required: VENC_C1 and VDEC_CORE need SPM status bit 19 (MDP, MDP_PWR_CON 0x34c, pg.c:190,561) on in 0x16c and 0x170, else EACCES, checked before any write (like the DIS check).
HIGH-3 last close: XNU spec_close calls d_close only when vcount==0 (bsd/miscfs/specfs/spec_vnops.c:2760, no D_TRACKCLOSE), but d_open runs per open. n2vc_dev_close frees ONE slot and calls n2vr_server_close() once, so after two opens of minor 0 (vcodecd + rwvc_probe) slots leak (EBUSY after 16) and server_opens never reaches 0 (server_present stuck at 1). Fix: at d_close destroy every slot of that minor and call n2vr_server_close() once per destroyed minor-0 slot (or reset server_opens). IK: the same applies to minor 1: d_close fires once for the LAST client process only, so per-process close notices for concurrent clients cannot come from d_close; document it (vcodecd must not rely on close notices when 2+ clients are open) or track liveness another way.
MED-4 sysram: Linux sets NON_SEC_CON bits 16-19 = 0xf on VENC ports 5,6,13,14,21,22 (smi_sysram_enable, smi_drv.c:498-524, called from mtk_vcodec_enc_pm.c:308-317) = route to MMSRAM. We do not power MMSRAM, so clear them: mask 0xfff01 instead of 0xff01 (write and read-back) for the VENC ports only. vcodecd must pass slbc_ready = 0 to the lib (hw-ip).
MED-5 both cores: mtk_vcodec_enc_clock_on enables larb7+VENC0 AND larb8+VENC1 for any core (mtk_vcodec_enc_pm.c:271-282); vcodecd should power VENC_C1 too if the lib touches the C1 window (vpud maps it).
INFO-6 real IRQ: ml_install_interrupt_handler stores ONE handler per CPU (osfmk/arm64/machine_routines.c:801-821); installing a VENC handler would replace Nord2GPU.cpp irqDispatch on that PE. A real VENC IRQ needs a chained dispatcher in Nord2GPU, not a second install. Stay polled (msleep) for v1. SPI 308 -> INTID 340 [V dts].
I implement HIGH-1/2/3 + MED-4 in my 0311 on top of your current file; if you change your file meanwhile, tell me when it is final (DONE rev N) and I rebase. Please do not renumber: 0299 is taken; the generated patch becomes 0310.
